answer.room: a small, empty, contemporary room with a white-walled corner, a wide black-framed window onto the street, an exposed concrete ceiling and a dark brown wood-look plank floor; a cool palette of white, grey and black that needs warmth

pieces.piece: a tall, wide dark-wood bookcase covering most of the left wall
pieces.why: it is the centerpiece the client asked for; in a dark wood like the floor, it fills the blank wall with books and brings warmth against the concrete and white walls
pieces.query:
Type: bookcase, tall wide open shelving
Use: storing many books; reading room
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern
Materials: dark wood, walnut veneer
Colors: dark walnut brown
Shape: tall and wide, many open shelves, clean lines, solid strong presence
Feel: warm, cultured, cozy
Goes with: dark brown wood floor, white walls, concrete ceiling, black window frames

pieces.piece: a comfortable reading armchair in the corner by the window
pieces.why: the window corner gives natural light for reading, and a deep upholstered armchair in a warm natural fabric softens the room's hard materials
pieces.query:
Type: armchair, deep upholstered lounge chair
Use: reading and relaxing; reading nook
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: boucle or linen upholstery, dark wood frame
Colors: warm cream, oatmeal, camel
Shape: deep generous seat, high back, rounded arms, wooden legs, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, enveloping, warm
Goes with: dark wood bookcase, dark brown floor, white walls, black window frames

pieces.piece: a floor lamp next to the armchair
pieces.why: it gives warm reading light at night, and a fabric shade with wood or black metal ties into the window and the bookcase
pieces.query:
Type: floor lamp, reading floor lamp
Use: reading light beside the armchair; reading nook
Style: mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: wood, black metal, linen fabric shade
Colors: natural wood, black, cream
Shape: slim stem, fabric shade or adjustable arm, light visual weight
Feel: warm, soft, inviting
Goes with: dark wood bookcase, cream armchair, black window frames

pieces.piece: a small round side table beside the armchair for coffee
pieces.why: it keeps the cup and the book within reach, and in solid wood it echoes the bookcase without taking up room
pieces.query:
Type: side table, small round wooden table
Use: holding coffee and a book; reading nook
Style: mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: solid dark wood
Colors: walnut brown
Shape: small round top, slim legs or pedestal base, light visual weight
Feel: warm, simple, practical
Goes with: dark wood bookcase, cream armchair, dark brown floor

pieces.piece: a light round rug under the armchair and side table
pieces.why: a light natural round rug defines the reading corner, brightens the dark floor and adds softness underfoot
pieces.query:
Type: rug, round natural fiber rug
Use: defining the reading corner; reading nook
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, bohemian
Materials: wool, jute, cotton
Colors: ivory, cream, natural beige
Shape: round, soft textured weave, about 160 to 200 cm across
Feel: soft, warm, natural
Goes with: dark brown wood floor, cream armchair, dark wood bookcase

pieces.piece: a throw blanket draped over the armchair
pieces.why: a natural knit or wool throw adds the textile warmth the client wants and invites long reading sessions
pieces.query:
Type: throw, knit blanket
Use: warmth while reading; reading nook
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian
Materials: wool, cotton
Colors: warm camel, terracotta, oatmeal
Shape: chunky texture, fringed edges
Feel: cozy, soft, warm
Goes with: cream armchair, natural rug, dark wood

pieces.why: a linen cushion gives back support while reading and repeats the room's warm natural textiles
pieces.query:
Type: cushion, linen lumbar pillow
Use: back support for reading; reading nook
Style: Japandi, Scandinavian
Materials: linen, cotton
Colors: rust, terracotta, warm beige
Shape: rectangular lumbar, textured weave
Feel: warm, natural, soft
Goes with: cream armchair, wool throw, dark wood

pieces.piece: light linen curtains for the wide window
pieces.why: sheer natural linen softens the black frame and the street view, filters the light for reading and warms the room
pieces.query:
Type: curtains, sheer linen curtain panels
Use: filtering daylight and softening the window; reading room
Style: Japandi, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: linen
Colors: natural off-white, warm ecru
Shape: floor-length, soft relaxed folds, light visual weight
Feel: airy, soft, warm
Goes with: black window frames, white walls, cream armchair, dark wood

pieces.piece: a potted plant in the corner by the window
pieces.why: a leafy plant in the window light repeats the tree outside and adds a natural touch to the reading corner
pieces.query:
Type: plant, tall leafy indoor plant
Use: bringing greenery to the reading corner; reading nook
Style: bohemian, Japandi
Materials: terracotta or woven basket pot
Colors: green, terracotta, natural
Shape: tall, full foliage, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, natural, calm
Goes with: dark wood, natural rug, linen curtains, white walls
